summary: Fifteen days to the Expo (booth 412 confirmed). Ranking PR #232 awaits Arjun's review, which gates the scoring API. Final picker screens are delivered. The Sep 28 postmortem is done and the Harbor export limit is fixed. Harbor wants a written reliability plan by Thursday's QBR. Pinecrest wants a demo first.

items.text: Nina's ranking PR #232 is up and needs Arjun's review before it can merge and be wired into the scoring API. Arjun's scoring endpoint also waits on this ranking.
Nina's ranking is in review (PR #232), ahead of her Wednesday Oct 21 commitment. Scoring API TW-115 is due Oct 28 and still needs the real ranking.
Sam delivered the final slot picker screens in Figma and Leila has them, which unblocks the picker UI. Sam moves to the Expo demo flow.
Sam needs realistic sample data for the three-screen live demo. Jordan will get an anonymized week of Coastal's bookings from Grace today. Coastal agreed.
Expo demo will be live, with a printed one-pager as backup. Demo shows booking, a Smart Slots suggestion, and the dock load evening out.
Pinecrest, needed as the third design partner, wants to see a live demo before signing. Without it, the goal of 3 live partners is at risk.
Coastal kickoff call is booked for Thursday. Valley is still waiting on data access. API docs for both are due Oct 26.
Arjun owes API docs for Coastal and Valley by Oct 26.
Jordan will send Expo invites to the 40-lead list on Friday. Lead list ticket due Oct 28.
Arjun finished the Sep 28 postmortem. Root cause: the sync worker crashed and nothing retried. Follow-ups are TW-104 (retry queue, in progress) and TW-105 (error alert, todo).
Nina fixed the Harbor 5,000-row export limit; exports over 5,000 rows now complete. This was previously deferred.
Dana asked for a written reliability plan before Thursday's QBR. Maya owns it, due Oct 22.
Jordan is preparing the Harbor QBR deck for Oct 22 and has Nina's Q3 usage numbers. Renewal is Oct 30. Maya spoke with Dana.
Harbor ops reports Fresno DC appointments show UTC times. Logged as TW-130 (API, Nina) and TW-132 (schedule view, Leila), both low priority.
Sync error rate was 1.6% (target under 1%), mostly Ridgeline duplicates. Ridgeline renews Nov 20, health yellow. TW-103 is unstarted. Deferred until after Expo unless it worsens.
Smart Slots stays the company priority until the Nov 4 Expo, with no side quests. Sync errors wait until after Expo unless they worsen.
Arjun has backend interviews Thursday and Friday with two candidates (TW-110). Nina is on call this week.
Maya has a booth design review with Sam on Wednesday. Investor update TW-111 is due Oct 23.
